name: PDFio tools
author: Michael R Sweet
description: PDF tools from PDFio: pdftotext extracts the text of a PDF, pdfinfo shows its details and pages, pdfmerge joins several PDFs. Type pdftotext document.pdf.
usage:
pdftotext: pdftotext FILE.pdf (text of every page to stdout; | head, > out.txt)
pdfinfo: pdfinfo FILE.pdf (title, author, dates, number of pages, page sizes)
pdfmerge: pdfmerge -o OUT.pdf IN1.pdf IN2.pdf ...
Scanned PDFs have no text (images only).

descriptions.en: PDF tools from PDFio: pdftotext extracts the text of a PDF, pdfinfo shows its details and pages, pdfmerge joins several PDFs. Type pdftotext document.pdf.
descriptions.it: Strumenti PDF di PDFio: pdftotext estrae il testo di un PDF, pdfinfo ne mostra dati e pagine, pdfmerge unisce più PDF. Scrivi pdftotext documento.pdf.

does.en: Read PDFs: text of every page, document info, merge PDFs. Run: pdftotext F.pdf | head -100 ; pdfinfo F.pdf ; pdfmerge -o OUT.pdf A.pdf B.pdf (scans: no text)
does.it: Leggere PDF: testo di ogni pagina, dati del documento, unione. Uso: pdftotext F.pdf | head -100 ; pdfinfo F.pdf ; pdfmerge -o OUT.pdf A.pdf B.pdf (scansioni: niente testo)
